topic: Fallen Astronaut statue on the Moon
hook: Your tiny statue sits on the Moon.
title: A Tiny Statue Has Sat on the Moon Since 1971
description:
Apollo 15 astronauts left a small aluminium figure called Fallen Astronaut on the Moon in 1971, beside Hadley Rille. It honours astronauts and cosmonauts who died in the exploration of space, and a plaque beside it lists their names. Part of the If You Were in Space series.

#Shorts #IfYouWereInSpace #Apollo15
